comment: Communities/districts along the Airport→Kingston→Bog Walk→Fern Gully→Ocho Rios route. Lat/lon are approximate — entries marked needs_owner_review:true should be verified against the owner's lived knowledge before release. Radius is in compressed world units (~400m real-world at scale=0.3).

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The iconic narrow peninsula — sea on both sides. Coconut tree corridor.

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: Roundabout at the end of the Palisadoes strip; gateway into Kingston.

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial/residential community on Windward Road approach.

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community; Rastafarian cultural significance.

communities.name: Mountain View
communities.note: Residential area along Mountain View Avenue.

communities.name: Cross Roads
communities.note: Major intersection in the heart of Kingston.

communities.name: New Kingston
communities.note: Kingston's commercial and financial district.

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The beating heart of uptown Kingston. Clock tower landmark.

communities.name: Vineyard Town
communities.note: Community along the Spanish Town Road corridor.

communities.name: Twickenham Park
communities.note: Semi-rural community along the Nelson Mandela Highway.

communities.name: Flat Bridge
communities.note: Historic low bridge over the Rio Cobre; iconic Bog Walk entrance.

communities.name: Bog Walk
communities.note: Town at the heart of the gorge; named for the surrounding bog.

communities.name: Ewarton
communities.note: Small community along the River Road approaching Linstead.

communities.name: Linstead
communities.note: Market town; the song 'Linstead Market' is known worldwide.

communities.name: Kellits
communities.note: Small community along the Linstead–Moneague road.

communities.name: Mount Rosser
communities.note: Hillside community before Moneague.

communities.name: Moneague
communities.note: Junction town in the interior; Camp Moneague nearby.

communities.name: Faith's Pen
communities.note: Famous roadside cookshops — jerk chicken, roast yam, festival. Don't skip.

communities.name: Angels
communities.note: Small community on the descent towards Fern Gully.

communities.name: Fern Gully
communities.note: Iconic canopied gully road — bamboo and tropical ferns overhead.

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Vibrant north-coast resort town. Dunn's River Falls awaits.
